_about: Structure and Category Dep names of the UOWA dashboard (Add Post form). Use node lookup.js to search; do not read this file whole.

sources.screenshots: screenshot_names_table.pdf: 120 of 128 Structures and 1,034 of about 1,044 Category names. Missing entries are NOT guessed.
sources.dashboard_dump: uowa-form-dump2.json: first 80 Structure names read straight from the dropdown. ar_verified=true means the Arabic matches it letter for letter.

notes: Categories are separate entries per language (Arabic post -> Arabic list, English post -> English list).
The lists do not say which Category belongs to which Structure.
"name" has screenshot artifacts removed (trailing dot or colon, leading quote). "raw" is the text as transcribed, kept only when it differs.
"check" marks entries that look like OCR noise: avoid them, or list them under Choices to confirm.
A Structure with an empty "en" has no English title in the dashboard.
